description: A verb the orchestrator's row of cli.json does not name is refused with the usage code 2, and the usage text names every verb of that row with its summary.

stderr_contains: analyze          Analyze every language in scope and write the merged report.
print-config     Print the resolved configuration with the provenance of every setting.
print-languages  Print the languages a run puts in scope, the analyzers it runs and the languages it leaves out, as one JSON object, an instance of contract/census.schema.json.
version          Print the product's version and the Contract version it implements.
